title: Louvre Museum Paris - Exclusive Guided Tour (Reserved Entry Included!)
description: Save yourself a lot of time at one of Paris' most popular attractions, the Louvre Museum, on this skip-the-line tour. Once you're inside, enjoy a guided tour of many of the collection's highlights, including famous and lesser-known works. Learn more about French and European history and culture through art. Art enthusiasts will especially love this in-depth tour.

reviews.usertext:
I just wanted to skip the line and get few interesting facts, what we got was so much more.
Our guide Duna, was amazing! Very knowledgeable. Her descriptions made pieces come to life.

We did see Mona Lisa, the line to it is pretty long but moved fast. Be prepared with your camera they only let you snap one photo and tell you to move on.

The museum is HUGE you have to be very selective about what to see. I would recommend going to Napoleon’s apartments. They were amazing.

Guide can give you a tickets once tour is over so you can roam on your own. You can connect to the Louvre WiFi it is free and research more about pieces that peak your interest.

Our tour guide, Barbara, was spectacular. Erudite, personable, considerate and incredibly knowledgeable. There were 6 of us on the tour and she was able to tailor the tour to our interests at the drop of a dime. Two adults on the tour were very knowledgeable in their own right and the dialogue between them and Barbara elevated the tour without alienating the three younger teens on the tour. Seeing the Louvre on one’s own is often overwhelming and this museum is so immense that taking a tour is an excellent way to get the most bang for one’s buck. We would highly recommend this tour. Please recognize that the Louvre is VERY crowded and it is sometimes difficult to hear your tour guide over the noise of other people. That being said, if your are interested in items off the beaten path, you will find yourself in rooms with hardly any crowds.

Our guide, Michele, or "Mitch" as he told us to call him, was incredible. My husband and I had never visited Paris, let alone the Louvre, and we couldn't have asked for a better experience being led around my Michele. He was extremely knowledgable and genuinely found joy in showing us the best parts of the museum. He also happened to speak four languages and I'm a huge language nerd, so we immediately bonded on that front. For anyone visiting the Louvre, whether it's their first or hundredth time, I highly recommend this private tour experience and definitely suggest asking for Michele, if possible. You won't regret it!

We did not have days to spend at the Louvre. Our guide Romain was the perfect answer for us. He gave us a wonderful experience allowing us to see highlights along with his fascinating narrative to bring the pieces we saw to life. I highly recommend a guide so you can make the most time of the time you have.

We had a fabulous time at our tour with Ivana today at the Louvre Museum. She was very knowledgeable, very accommodating to our interests and was the sweetest with our 2 year old daughter. Highly recommend this tour with Ivana, there is no way we would have been able to see all of the art we wanted in that amount of time without her knowledge and guidance. Thank you!

We highly recommend getting a private tour of the Louvre, and this one did not disappoint!

Our guide, Michele, was incredible. He was so passionate and animated about the art and the history - it was contagious. We learned so much through him, and really appreciated the highlights he provided. He was also really funny and relaxed, which made it really enjoyable. The length of the tour was perfect -- not too much, just the right amount of time.

Thank you Michele!

We did our private tour with Ivana and could not have been happier with our experience. If it was possible to give more than 5 stars, we would. She was so knowledgeable about the artwork we saw and the historical context surrounding each piece and the Louvre more generally. Having been in Paris for almost two weeks before this tour, we still learned new information and had new perspectives during our time at the museum. This tour is absolutely worth the price - you get an impeccable guide and get to hit all the “must see” works with extra free time at the end of your tour to explore on your own. We loved Ivana and so hope to have her on another tour in the future.

This was a wonderful experience altogether. As someone who greatly enjoys visiting museums, specifically art museums, it was so wonderful to see the highlights of such a large collection with such interesting stories and historical knowledge from our guide, Roman. He was excellent. So entertaining and knowledgeable of all exhibits. Roman was always attentive if we had a question or wanted to focus on a specific historic period in the Louvre. Access-wise, the private security entrance was incredibly useful and helped us beat the large crowd forming early in the morning. All in all, I recommend this activity for its privacy and ease of access, exciting history from a local guide, and overall tailored experience.

Our guide, Zdravko, was knowledgeable, experienced, and fun, with a nice flare for telling a colorful story that helped one remember the finer points of art history. I’m sure that our first time in the Louvre would have felt completely overwhelming if we had not first taken a guided tour. Thank you, Z, for a really enjoyable day and a wonderful, memorable experience of one of the most incredible museums in the world!!

Lilya (spelling?) was outstanding. She knew what we wanted to see and she made that happen. Along the way she provided deep background information demonstrating a thorough understanding of the history involved. She took us initially to the lesser visited portions of the museum so we could see interesting artifacts without all of the crowding, but she ended up working us into the big three: 1) Mona Lisa, 2) Winged Victory, and 3) Venus de Milo. One of my traveling companions had hurt his back and had difficulty walking. She arranged for us to get a wheelchair and she intimately knew where the lifts would be to ease our tour. She also spoke perfect English, including the idioms that are hard to master. She is outstanding!

Fantastic experience for first time visit to The Louvé. Our guide, Romain, was outstanding in his knowledge of history, the museum and how to maximize the experience in the museum. He is the best guide we have ever had! We enjoyed his enthusiasm and passion for the sites. We saw many significant pieces away from the crowds and at his appropriate suggestion, we did not waste our time with him waiting in queue to be up close to Mona Lisa, but did see it on our own. He was very respectful of our groups needs. We would not have been able to negotiate the museum with an audio guide as first time visitors.

While this tour is expensive, it is worth your money to have a true expert guiding you at the Louvre. The Museum has so much to see, that you want your time well spent. Emanuelle did an excellent job highlighting the major attractions of the Louvre and linking to major themes in western art

It is impossible to see even significant highlights of the Louve without a guide! And, without a guide to elucidate items of special interest, one would be deprived of an enriching experience.
After 2-1/2 hours we had seen only maybe half of one wing...a great exhibition of some of the better known items for an overview, but need 4 hours a day for a full week to feel like you saw a significant part of the museum collection which is on display... not to mention that what is on display is only a fraction of the museum collection.

We spent the morning with Daniel. He was quite entertaining and very much aware of how to maneuver the crowds at the Louvre while still giving you a full Louvre experience. We really enjoyed our time with him, He was most energetic and full of all kinds of amazing information. Thank you for a lovely visit.

So glad that we planned ahead and purchased this guided tour. Our guide for the afternoon (Marcel) gifted us with so many wonderful insights while navigating what was a very busy and crowded day at the museum. The details and information that we received were above and beyond any museum tour we’ve ever had. Thank you Marcel for making this trip to The Louvre so memorable!!

Flo greeted us on-time and was very engaging. He gave a very thorough but not intimidating overview and pointed out highlights with details that gave us context for the various exhibits.
He made it very fun distilling a rather overwhelming environment into an intelligible group of details that made us feel like we received a great orientation to this fantastic museum.
He could not have been nicer and more engaging.
We cannot recommend this tour highly enough.

Thank you Flo for a great experience!

Lili was a superb host on our fabulous tour of the Louvre. She was on time, communicating with us beforehand to be sure all was well. After skipping the line she took us in a fabulous journey through art and time. Her passion And academic background permeated her informative and always engaging commentary, taking time for questions, and to check in on our welfare as we proceeded. She may have even inspired my teen to take history for her senior studies. As for the skip the line tour, my heart sank as I saw the thousands of people snaking around the pyramid, and it was such a relief to have Lili guide us through the quick way, even finding the uncrossed toilets for us. Most importantly if you want to learn more about art and be impassioned by an expert, ask for Lili.

louvre
Let me start by saying, I my wife did not want to go to the Louvre. Her theory is she can pull almost anything up on the internet and see what’s hanging / displayed in a gallery. But what she lacks in interest for original art, she makes up for in interest for history - and our tour to the Louvre left her wanting more.

Our tour guide, Liliya, was a history major, and she told us amazing stories about the Louvre, the art, and the history of both. The Louvre itself has served as a fortress, with the original foundation accessible under the building (we walked through he moat), as well as a palace, and now a museum and home to the Crown Jewels. We learned about what it was like in the time of Catherine d’Medici and Napoleon. I learned that Napoleon was not short, and we learned some fascinating stories about the art and artists. She described art as the Twitter of the time, and how it started wars, warned of outcomes of wars, etc. We learned not how to look at this angle or that one, or brush strokes and chisels, but how while some artists carved whole pieces of a statue at a time, deVinci stopped and started on different parts of the body and still created a statue that was symmetrical and balanced. While the Mona Lisa was not the best thing I saw in the museum, the story behind her painting did make her that much more fascinating. My wife will spend more time googling her later. Even if you don’t love art, this was a great tour with tons of information.

In other news, the communication, booking and meeting were all very easy. If you’re on the fence, or even in the “I’m only doing this because my spouse/partner wants to” - you won’t regret it. Ask for Liliya - she made it so much more interesting.

The semi private guided tour is an excellent way to see the Louvre on your first visit. The Louvre can be overwhelming because of its size. The guide not only helps navigate the museum, but she also gave excellent insights to each area and the individual pieces that she covered. We saw the highlights in the 4 hours during the tour. Then we could continue to use our ticket and pick and choose the other areas we wanted to see. Obviously, you can’t see everything. I would highly recommend that you have an area that you would like to focus.

10/10! A great way to see the Louvre in an organized way with a small group as opposed to aimlessly wandering around since it’s so massive. Dunja was an amazing guide, providing so much background and insight into the various pieces of art, artists, styles, etc. It really made the tour that much better!

Dasha was early, like our party was, so we were able to start early. Recommend the private tour and skip the line tours to maximize your time there. The Louvre is a massive undertaking and she was an excellent guide. The museum's history, art, surrounding landmarks were described in chronologic order, succinctly, and in excellent detail! Highly recommend the tour and the tour guide. I don't think I would venture alone in the museum without a guide, as the size of the ground and amount of displays can be overwhelming.

Our guide Kotryna was fantastic. We easily found her at the meeting spot and greatly appreciated her guidance, insight, and positive attitude. She was extremely knowledgeable about art and the Louvre and greatly enriched our entire experience. Easy booking through Babylon Tours. We highly recommend a guided tour of the Louvre highlights and will absolutely book another guided tour when we return to beautiful Paris.

We had the most wonderful morning with Lili. She looked after us all beautifully and made the history of the Louvre, Paris, Greece and art come alive. My 14 year old granddaughter and I felt we learnt so many of the wonderful nuggets of art and history the Louvre has to offer. The piece of art she choose to go into detail about were very interesting and relevant to many different points in history, as well have having influence on many modern day practices. We would have no hesitation to recommend Lili to all ages as we were a group of 14-92, she did an amazing job of making sure everyone was engaged and enjoying the tour. If we come back to Paris, I would seek out Lili again.

Julien was a great guide, on time, kept the visit interesting as we rushed from one unique piece of art to another.

The Louvre is amazing yet you really need a great guide to really enjoy.

I highly recommend

We booked the private tour on our last day in Paris and it surpassed all our expectations. Our guide, Oliver Knightman, was fun, clever, and so engaging. After days of running around in Paris, we were so tired that we debated either canceling this last tour or shortening it. We were not in the mood for a long lecture on art, but Oliver turned it all around for us.

When we started the tour we told Oliver to make it very brief since we were were exhausted and Oliver took us up on the challenge with a friendly attitude! He was so kind and accommodating, he cheered us up with his witty commentary of art and how it has been shaped by history, politics, ideologies of France and how the art and artists here have influenced the world. At times a critic, at times a fan, we ended up cracking up at Oliver’s perspectives and left feeling educated and entertained at the same time. No lectures, so fun, light and deep at the same time. We ended up almost doing the entire tour and forgetting we were tired. It was a highlight of our trip.

Oliver is a master of tours and highly recommend a tour with him!

Alex was the best guide. He is extremely knowledgable, engaging, friendly, funny and kind. I couldn't have asked for a better guide. The Lourve is overwhelmingly large and he was able to show us the highlights, have a great time, all without it feeling overwhelming. Skipping the lines was a great benefit as well. Highly recommend for anyone who has never been to the Lourve or wants a tailored experience! Thanks!

Oliver was an amazing tour guide for our group, who had a range of art novices to those passionate about art and he appealed to everyone. He had a great way of telling a story to engage everyone in the art. The Louvre can be overwhelming and Oliver did a wonderful job showing us the highlights and walking us through multiple areas so we had a variety of things to see. He went even further by providing us recommendations for dining and other activities around the city. He has been the highlight of our Paris trip thus far.

Lili made the museum live for our two teenage girls. They are still talking about it three days later. She took us to just the right spots so we could cruise through the museum without having to look at all 37,000 pieces.

We met our guide, Daniel, in the courtyard and waited about 30 minutes for a late couple who never arrived. Daniel kept in contact with them and finally determined we must begin. The mixture of humor and history was delightful and Daniel is a great storyteller! He was especially kind and sensitive to our ages (I’m 66 and my husband 79) so we stopped in areas where we could sit!

We had an amazing experience at the Louvre. Our tour guide was Anastasia, she is very knowledgeable, personable and sweet. Our group consisted of my husband and I and our 15 & 17 years old teenage daughters. Needless to say, our teenage daughters didn’t want for us to book tours, they wanted to visit everything on our own like if we were locals. Off course, we didn’t listen and book this private tour anyway. They ended up understanding how much better the experience is when someone as knowledgeable as Anastasia take you straight to the things we wanted to see, sharing with us valuable information and making sure we had a memorable time. We recommend this tour to anyone who likes a VIP treatment and wants to make the best out of their time.

Our tour guide was Lili and she was amazing. We did the 2.5 hour semi private tour and it was so worth it. Lili was efficient in navigating the crowds and getting us to the right areas, she was very knowledgeable of all the pieces - art history degree- and was funny and kept us interested. She was great at knowing the best sides of the pieces, the quiet areas to provide the background and explaining the history and detail and then giving us time to take pictures. Overall, we had an amazing experience and would HIGHLY recommend! Be ready to walk, and wear comfortable shoes. There are also stairs involved, a few times.

My family is part of a group of 3 families (7 people). It's a good size because you get to know new friends and more importantly you won't get overwhelmed by the tour guide's dedicated attention. We hired a one-on-one back in Florence Uffizi Museum, and it was tiring.

Nancy (a UK young beautiful girl) is our tour guide and our teenage boy enjoyed Nancy's knowledge of history, painting, and languages a lot. My wife and I certainly appreciate her profession and humor. It's a personal bonding at the end of the tour. We loved it.

Last but not least, I think there is an overlooked perk that we didn't know about before the tour is the quiet restroom access for groups. It's important when visiting a major museum like Louvre. That's it. Bon tour.

My sister and I had the best time on our private tour with Michele! He was very knowledgeable, personable, and excited about what he was showing us! He messaged us in the morning so we knew where to meet him and how to identify him. He arrived early like us so we were able to get an early start as well. We ended up going through the main parts fairly quickly, so he was kind enough to show us some of his favorite spots which included the apartments and french sculptures. If you have time the apartments are a must-see for any history buffs. I can't say enough good things about our experience, and he gave us great pastry and food recommendations as well. The Louvre is huge and quite the maze, and having a tour guide made it a stress free and fun experience!

We booked a tour with Babylon based on the reviews and were not disappointed. On a busy Friday, Daniel navigated the crowds while filling us in on lots of rich, entertaining history. We asked him questions about other pieces of art besides just the highlights, and he had interesting answers for all of them. I ran into some logistical issues getting over to the Louvre and he was unbelievably helpful in working out a solution. Highly recommend.

This was a great way to get exposed to a small, but crucial number of works of art that are permanently featured at the Louvre. Alex, our tour guide, was phenomenal in not only keeping the tour moving, but spending time explaining key works of art, their significance, their history at the Louvre, and their place in the arc of art history. Highly recommend this tour. As someone who has studied art in the US and coming to France for the first time, I came away feeling as though I had learned a ton. Thank you!!

Alex was a wonderful guide! We experienced the Louve in a whole new way with his knowledge and guidance. The Louve is a VERY large museum and having your own private guide is almost essential. Alex is a very pleasant man who was able to make the tour not only enjoyable for me and my sister but also our 98 year old mother.

Oliver was a fantastic guide - very knowledgeable about the Louvre and the pieces we were looking at, as well as history of many other sites in Paris that he shared along the way. He was also great with our kids (ages 6 and 11). We really enjoyed our time on this tour, and felt it was much more interesting and informative than just following along with an audioguide. We would highly recommend this tour, and Oliver in particular as a guide.

We booked a private tour and were guided by Kotrina. She was excellent. Very knowledgeable, amiable, and even threw in a little humor. She tailored the visit to our preferences (the Louvre is huge) and then gave us advice on the rest of the museum and the area after the tour. I would highly recommend them.

This tour was 1000% worth it. Oliver was our guide and he was absolutely amazing throughout our time together. He was able to navigate the crowds and massive museum with ease. We all sincerely appreciated his background (he has a masters in art) and how he explained the periods of the pieces, the artists styles, and much more. It was an invaluable experience and we could have spent hours with him walking us through different parts of the museum. Highly recommend this!

Eduardo was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the exhibits we visited. He was very engaging, sharing intriguing stories about the history of each piece. We were in a group of six which we found very comfortable and easy to hear. I would definitely recommend this tour and we would gladly go on another tour with Eduardo.

Firstly having a private tour is the absolute best way to experience the Louvre and learn all you can especially if you only have one trip. Tina was incredibly knowledgeable on everyhting we saw and took us through in a way that was able to tell the story of the development of the arts. You get all the info or art, history and culture in one. Tina was the perfect guide and after gave us some fantastic recommendations for our trip in Paris, couldn't recommend her more highly.

Our tour guide, Sean, was very knowledgeable and provided us with a wonderful tour of the museum. He made sure that we saw the highlights of the museum and gave us details and stories of the building and art. In our experience, a guided tour is the best and most efficient way to visit a museum! Highly recommend this tour!!!

Emma was a great tour guide! She explained the history of various pieces of art and also pointed out some famous works that I never seen or heard about. Sometimes Emma gives some close visuals on an ipad while she's explaining the work of art. I would highly recommend getting a tour with her!!

My wife and I are in Paris with friends for the first time. So of course on our list of things to do and see was the Louvre. Our tour was a great success all due to our guide, Eduardo, who was pleasant, cordial, amusing but above all highly informative giving us details and historic background that gave life and meaning to the artifacts and artwork. If you take this tour, especially a private one, request Eduardo.

It was a perfect experience! Florent was a fantastic guide who made sure we learned about the Louvre’s and French history overall, which is something I didn’t fully understand until today. He also gave interesting context around all the major artworks in the Louvre’s collection.

My 12-year-old who was wary of me “dragging” her to another museum because art doesn’t interest her as much really enjoyed herself.

Also being able to skip the line was a huge relief.

He made visiting the museum feel manageable yet special! I highly recommend Florent.

Brace yourself to immerse into some incredible paintings, sculptures, etc. I learnt from our guide that there are 39000 exhibits inside. So it can take you over 100 days to see all of them if you a minute per exhibit for around 6 hours a day. We did a 2.5 hour guided tour. Short and sweet. A must visit..After all its the largest museum in the world

Our guide Lucia was an absolute pleasure to be with. Her knowledge of art was exceptional. Through her my wife and I learned a new appreciation of how art is to be viewed. Through Lucia we were able to see what the artist was trying to convey through their eyes, the sutleties of lines in the art work. Anyone who is lucky enough to have Lucia as a guide will not be disappointed and will have a rich experience

Our Irish tour guide, Daniel, was nothing short of awesome. He was engaging, entertaining, had a wonderful sense of humor and really drew the four of us into the information he had to share. I’m not sure that we could have asked for a more wonderful, pleasant experience. I would highly recommend and would ask specifically for him to be our guide if I were to be in Paris again and need a guide.

Michele met us outside the Louvre near the Statue of Louis XIV.

Passionate about the Louvre and the amazing art within, especially the history and stories he shared during this fast-moving journey through history and art. Not only did he show and share countless treasures, but he so with a passion which was heartwarming. We loved this tour and the experience that Michele provided, and we are thankful we met him. Mercie Bou Coup!

You haven’t seen Paris until you visit the Louvre. My wife and scored big time when we had the fortune to be paired with Tina, our private tour guide. Her exuberance, energetic storytelling and vast knowledge of the artifacts, art and history captured our attention from beginning to end. To our delight, Tina was able to navigate the labyrinth of this vast museum escorting us through back doors, hidden corridors and private elevators in what seemed like a very private VIP celebrity experience, weaving us in and out of the most exquisite rooms. I can’t imagine doing it any other way.

An absolute highlight of our long weekend in Paris! Taylor was an exceptional guide with unbelievable knowledge of all elements of the Louvre who took the time to answer all of our (many) questions. We typically do private tours when we travel (Vatican, etc) but this was the best. Easy entry with skip the line and perfect timing. We would recommend the private tour to all, but make sure you ask for Taylor - she surpassed our (high) expectations! A+

Belen was great. While we certainly didn’t have time to cover the entire museum, she ensured we hit all the key pieces and explained the differences and connection between the eras with interesting and informative tales, history, and symbolism. We’re off to Musee D’Orsay tomorrow - hoping to have Belen again!

P.s. she takes great photos for us to memorialize our visit!!

Excellent tour with very knowledgeable guide. We’ll worth it through the Louvre! Very highly recommend a private tour! We walked right in with absolutely no wait on a very high volume day. The guide showed us key artifacts and paintings with clear explanations of the history of the object. She also had an excellent knowledge of the museum layout which allowed for easy movement throughout and access to restrooms with no line

Great experience, Daniel offered us the most useful 3 hours I can remember.
We have seen the most valuable exhibits, he gave us precise informations, just to keep in mind what is important. And everything in a relaxed, natural way.
I realized going by yourself in such an impressive place without someone to guide you to highlights of the museum, to teach you, is a nonsense. A private tour offers you the opportunity to see and ask exactly what you are interested in, without making you feel uneducated and illiterate in front of such an explosion of culture. And a guide like Daniel makes you feel you have read a bunch of art books in 3 hours.
The only regret I have is that I haven't done that before, at other museums.

Alex was our official interesting and passionate tour guide at The Louvre. He brought both the sculptures and paintings to life with his details and story telling.
Definitely recommend this tour for all. We are a family of 5 from all ages who learned so much.

Our guide was Michele and he was excellent. He was personable, friendly and professional, and amazingly knowledgeable. He was able to clearly explain so much of what we were seeing and the museum builings themselves. Worth the expense as we felt we got 5 times the info if we were to do it on our own and read or google search things on our own.
Thank you Michele once again, you were excellent.

Wow! What an experience this was! My family and I will never forget this tour. Our guide Zdravko (or Z as he told us to call him) is an artist himself and he gave us his wonderful perspective as well as incredible stories and history of some of the world’s most famous pieces of art.

He made sure we saw “The Big Three” (Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo and The Winged Victory of Samothrace. But he also found some incredible pieces that had really interesting stories and techniques behind the art. Even my teen daughters stayed interested.

We are so glad we did this tour! And thank you, Z! We hope your art is in there one day!

This was an excellent way to see the Louvre. There’s so much more to this amazing museum than just the Mona Lisa, and our amazing guide, Romain, took us through a great walk of history and art, showing us both known and unknown pieces at the museum. He was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating for our children of varying ages. I highly recommend this way to visit the Louvre.

We had a great time as a family in this private tour. Edoardo was so knowledgable and passionate about the museum, showed us around and we appreciated all the details he shared with us. It would have been lost time if we had tried to do it on our own, with all the thousands of people around us all the time. Well worth the investment!

Guide was super knowledgeable and tailored our experience as he learned our preferences. Took us to all three wings and hit all the highlights. He also knew a lot about the history of the Louvre and took us to the foundation areas discovered more recently.

Leah was very clear and easy to understand. She told us interesting stories about the several places we stopped. The Louvre has over 34,000 pieces of art so it is impossible to cover even a small fraction but she did a great job of taking us through the history.

Very knowledgeable tour guide! Highly recommend this tour and Tina! Tina helped us weave through the Louvre while giving us an in-depth background of the palace and it's famous works of art. We appreciated her profound knowledge. Her English was perfect with barely an accent, which was very helpful for our young kids too.

We, as a group, cannot say enough about how awesome this tour was. First and foremost, our guide, Michele (Mitch), was superb! He was there to greet us at the time/place agreed upon when we made the reservation. He was personable, interesting, knowledgeable, courteous, had a great sense of humor and an obvious passion for art and as a tour guide. We would have been lost on our own! We truly enjoyed the entire experience, can say without a doubt, if we did not do the tour, we would not have had as great a time. Oh, and did I mention, we did not have wait on line to get in, or for the bathrooms (he directed as to a special area for guided tours!). Was a true highlight of our trip an we recommend the company but more importantly our guide Mitch.

This was a great tour to see the highlights of the Louvre, especially given the sheer size of the place. I was so grateful to have Michele as my tour guide. Not only was he knowledgeable and friendly, but he really took the time to ensure the tour was catered to our interests. We also got to see the museum's most famous artifacts/paintings. He also gave us the best tips for photos, and he took great care to ensure everyone was having an amazing time. It's easy to get overwhelmed by how huge this place is, but Michele made it memorable and fun.

Our tour guide Lijiljana Perovic was fantastic! She is incredibly knowledgeable with two MA’s in art history. She was so attentive, explained so much and answered all our questions, making our visit to the Louvre fun and also educational. It is one thing to see a beautiful work of art, and another to actually understand it’s history and meaning. Also, she telephoned us in advance, met us right on time, and zipped us right in. She even spent and additional 15 minutes with us after the tour was over . We give Babylon and our tour guide in particular an A+.

Daniel with Babylon Tours was our guide and did a great job! He guided us through the entry and checking bags. He then led us on a comprehensive tour of the museum starting below ground with the foundations of the original building. He took us seamlessly through corridors and up and down stairs to take us to the highlights of the Louvre. He always provided information and background on what we were seeing making it an enriching experience.

We were so happy with Eduardo who was an excellent guide for the Louvre Skip the Line Private Tour. His background of working at the Louvre helped him give us guidance and context which was so insightful for our tour. His art history knowledge is extensive, yet he makes the tour very interesting and fun. Eduardo has an approach which presents a chronological tour of major works in the Louvre while also including stops at all of the Louvre’s superstars. Eduardo was a superb guide, we are so pleased he was our guide.

This tour was incredible! Lilliya was a fantastic guide, she had an amazing fount of knowledge. She made sure to take us to all of the top works and included a lot of the history of how the Lourve was built, who lived there and when it was expanded.

As a solo traveler, I was so grateful that Lillya took pictures of me!

I loved seeing Venus de Milo, Nike, the code of Hammurabi, going into the basement and learning about the moat and the construction of the first bricks when it was still a castle.

I cannot wait to go back!

Nancy was amazing! I’ve visited the Louvre during past trips to Paris and Nancy is my favorite guide. Nancy is well versed on the history of Paris, France and the Louvre and her perspective is refreshing! Nancy is very inclusive, aware of her audience and respectful of other visitors in the space. Nancy reached out to us early to ensure our group had all the information needed for the day. Nancy’s ability to communicate across cultures and perspectives while centering the art and artists, should be celebrated by your organization. Nancy is very professional and attentive to detail. My wife and I have visited Paris in the past, and we’ve been to the Louvre before, but on a recent trip, we thought it would be nice to revisit the museum and see it again with a private guide. We’ve always felt like wandering around the Louvre on our own made it hard to really get a feel for things in such a large place, and we’ve always just ended up seeing the most touristy and crowded sections of the museum. We figured that by signing up for a private tour with a guide, we’d be able to get a fresh perspective on the museum and see new and interesting things that are a bit more off-the-beaten-track and unique. Unfortunately, the tour we booked with Babylon ended up being very disappointing, especially after reading so many glowing reviews. However, I did appreciate that the company offered good customer service when I told them I was unhappy, proactively offering a full refund.

Prior to our tour, we received good instructions from Babylon via email on exactly where to go to meet our guide, which was at the Louis XIV statue just outside the museum’s pyramid. The email even included a photo of the statue to alleviate any confusion. Especially for anyone who hadn’t been to Paris or the museum before, it would have been very helpful information. Closer to the tour itself, I received contact information for our guide, along with her contact information if we needed to contact her. The only thing that was confusing when arrived was that there were so many tours meeting at the same spot, and she didn’t have any sort of sign for Babylon or way to identify who she was. It took a minute of awkwardly walking around until we managed to connect with her. I’d recommend that Babylon send either a photo of the tour guide in advance, or have the guide hold up a sign to better identify themselves.

Although our guide seemed nice and I believe she meant well, we felt that her tour was unprofessional. That was probably part of why we weren’t sure she was the guide at first. Her appearance was rather unkempt, so I never would have guessed that she was a professional guide based on the first impression.

As we started the tour outside the museum, which did include good information about the history of the building itself that we didn’t know, she asked if we had been there before. We said that we had been before, but felt like we didn’t get a great feel for the museum in the past. Our guide knew right up front that this was not our first visit, so I would have expected the tour to be customized with that in mind. Instead, we ended up just going on the most basic tour that took us to the same exact spots as we had visited before and that every tourist sees.

Our guide also told us on the way in that she hadn’t been to the Louvre in over a year, so she would use us as a test in hopes she’d remember everything. I don't think it’s professional to say this to clients who are paying a premium rate for a private tour. It made it seem like she didn't have much specialized knowledge of the museum, regardless of whether she was joking or not. Even if she was joking, especially in light of changes since Covid, I’d expect a professional guide to have already been there before going with their first guests since the pandemic. Right from the start, she wasn’t instilling a lot of confidence in her abilities or professionalism.

We then had issues trying to enter the museum. The first problem occurred when a security guard noted that the time on our tickets that the guide had provided was for an afternoon entry, but we were there at 10:00 am. The guide seemed surprised by this and said that the office must have sent the wrong tickets. I’m sure this was an honest mistake, but again, it felt like a professional guide would have been more on top of it and at least checked the tickets in advance to make sure they were correct. We then had to stand to the side and couldn’t enter the museum until she could get someone on the phone to get new tickets sent. Luckily, she was able to make contact and get the new tickets quickly, but it was just embarrassing and unprofessional to have this happen.

Another unprofessional item was that the guide’s phone had a completely shattered screen. This caused issues with tickets and photos. It was hard to scan the tickets at the entrance after we finally got ones for the correct time, almost preventing us from going in a second time. She also had a variety of photos on her phone to show us to supplement the items discussed on the tour, but we could barely see them when she’d try to show us on her cracked phone.

Once we did finally get into the museum, we felt like the private tour was very formulaic, with pre-determined items to see that were exactly the same as every other tour group in the museum. We went straight into the most crowded sections with Greek and Roman antiquities, followed by seeing Venus de Milo, and then a few other rooms in the area near the Mona Lisa, ending at the Mona Lisa. While this tour would be ok for first-time visitors and it did include what most would call the highlights of the Louvre, we basically saw all the same rooms/works of art that we had already seen last time, when we followed a free self-guided itinerary that I had found online. It would have been nice to see some galleries that are more of “hidden gems” of the Louvre, rather than following the crowds the whole time. There was one larger group tour in particular that we were constantly with, and I wished I had just paid a lot less to be with that group.

Much of the guide’s commentary about individual pieces of art was interesting and well-executed, but it was just the unprofessional nature of the whole thing and fact that we were in such basic, crowded sections of the museum that bothered us. The guide also made a few comments about Covid that seemed reckless and a bit flippant with regard to safety, so it didn’t make us the most comfortable that she always stood very close when giving information and would often take her mask off to talk, which wasn’t appropriate given the museum guidelines.

We must not have looked particularly happy during the tour, since the guide started asking us repeatedly toward the end if we were ok. It was just over and over “are you ok?” “are you ok?”. I probably should have communicated a bit more at that point that we weren’t totally happy, but we had been trying to give her the benefit of the doubt and hoped that the tour would get better. However, it just didn’t. Rather than make a big issue out of it, we just wanted to cut our losses and be done. We declined to wait in line for the Mona Lisa since we had seen it before, and we parted ways shortly after that, a little bit earlier than the full 2.5 hours allotted for the tour.

My wife and I were just so disappointed in this tour. We thought we were getting a unique tour that an art-lover would customize to share their knowledge and show us special parts of the Louvre, and we got such a basic tour with an unprofessional guide.

Later that day, we received a survey email from Babylon asking how our tour was. The email said that if we wanted to give the tour any less than 4 out of 5 stars, we should email them directly so any issues could be resolved using their guarantee policy. I decided to email to say that I wasn’t totally satisfied, and see what the response would be. Before even providing any details, I very quickly had an email back giving a full refund of our 300 Euro tour cost, also asking if I could elaborate on why I was unhappy.

I was impressed that they didn’t even need to hear any details before giving a refund. They seemed to truly stand by the idea of satisfaction being guaranteed. I sent a reply email going into more details on why we were unhappy, and I was impressed that the response I received wasn’t aggressive or defensive at all. Instead, Babylon continued to be totally apologetic, said that the issues we had should never have happened, and said that they had talked to the guide to offer feedback for her future tours. If we couldn’t go back in time and have a good tour, Babylon did what they could to make up for the situation and make us feel better.
